headline: Protect Desk reading space and responsive image delivery.

items.title: Keep Spark clear of reading text
items.insight: A current 390px Desk capture shows the fixed Spark buddy covering route-through-story text. Clearance only measures interactive controls. The existing mechanism supplies the foundation for a focused repair.
items.evidence: Before/after real-browser captures and a hash-bound reviewed receipt; browser regressions prove text clearance, return when clear, header recall, both corners and existing control behavior.

items.title: Check every responsive HTML image candidate
items.insight: The existing extractor checks href/src only. An image with a valid fallback and a missing srcset candidate passes, although selected viewports receive a 404. The existing mechanism supplies the foundation for a focused repair.
items.evidence: Gate fails a missing responsive candidate despite valid src; handles width/density descriptors, data URL commas, entities, multiple attributes, templates and external bases; current tracked public pages pass.
